coverLetter.subject: Work-Study Application – Digital Marketing & Growth (4 days company / 1 day school)
coverLetter.paragraph:
Attentive to your company's digital innovations and web development initiatives, I am eager to propose my candidacy as a work-study Webmaster to manage your digital platforms, optimize web performance, and boost discoverability.

Driven by an entrepreneurial and self-taught mindset, I combine technical execution with UI/UX sensibility. This approach has enabled me to independently build high-impact web products: scaling self-published mobile applications to over 2M+ cumulative downloads, and developing a health information database for people living with irritable bowel syndrome.

Operationally, I bring proven execution across CMS management (WordPress, WooCommerce, PrestaShop), front-end integration, and organic search (SEO, ASO, GEO). I also leverage AI on a daily basis to build custom automations that streamline content operations and technical audits, while maintaining strict critical judgment over outputs. Fully fluent in English (C2 level), French, and Arabic, I collaborate effectively in international teams.

Currently admitted to the Digital Communication, Social Media and Community Management program at ISCOM on a 4-day company / 1-day school schedule, I am eager to channel this autonomy and web execution power into your team's ambitions.
coverLetter.closing: I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your upcoming goals during an interview.
